_comment: Drop-in MCP config for the Kontent Zavod factory. See docs/14-mcp-setup.md for setup, credentials and trade-offs. After editing, restart Claude Code to load the servers.

higgsfield._comment: Official hosted MCP. 30+ image/video models (Veo, Sora, Kling, Flux, Nano Banana, Seedance, Soul). OAuth in the browser on first call — no API key needed here.

posteverywhere._comment: Official PostEverywhere MCP. Publishes / schedules to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest. Replace the API key with your own from posteverywhere.ai → Settings → Developers.

postiz._comment: Self-hosted Postiz MCP. Free, blueprint's default publisher. POSTIZ_URL is your own Postiz instance, POSTIZ_API_KEY is the per-user key from Postiz Settings → API. Disable this block if you don't self-host Postiz yet.

ayrshare_docs._comment: Ayrshare's documentation MCP. Read-only. Use it when wiring Ayrshare HTTP calls inside n8n — it lets the agent answer 'how do I post a YouTube Short with the Ayrshare API?'. NOT a publisher itself.
